rules.title: SSL 2.0 / SSL 3.0 Obsolete Protocol
rules.description: Critical deduction for obsolete SSL protocol susceptible to trivial cryptanalysis.

rules.title: TLS 1.0 / TLS 1.1 Deprecated Protocol
rules.description: High deduction for deprecated TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols lacking modern AEAD support.

rules.title: NULL Cipher / Plaintext Transport
rules.description: Critical deduction for cleartext transport or null cipher negotiation enabling passive sniffing.

rules.title: RC4 Obsolete Stream Cipher
rules.description: Substantial deduction for RC4 keystream bias vulnerabilities.

rules.title: 64-bit Block Cipher (3DES / DES)
rules.description: Deduction for use of a legacy 64-bit block cipher such as 3DES/DES.

rules.title: CBC-Mode Cipher Suite Usage
rules.description: Deduction for use of legacy CBC-mode cipher suites.

rules.title: Static RSA Key Exchange
rules.description: Deduction for lack of forward secrecy allowing retrospective decryption.

rules.title: Weak Diffie-Hellman Modulus (<2048-bit)
rules.description: Deduction for weak DH parameters vulnerable to discrete logarithm precomputations.

rules.title: Expired X.509 Certificate
rules.description: Deduction for expired certificate in validation path.

rules.title: Premature / Not-Yet-Valid Certificate
rules.description: Deduction for certificate observed before its notBefore timestamp.

rules.title: Inadequate RSA Key Size (<2048-bit)
rules.description: Deduction for sub-2048-bit public key failing modern security margins.

rules.title: Legacy Signature Algorithm (MD5 / SHA-1)
rules.description: Deduction for certificate signature using broken digest algorithm.

rules.title: Self-Signed Certificate Presented
rules.description: Deduction for untrusted self-signed certificate lacking verifiable root path.

rules.title: STARTTLS Downgrade / Cleartext Stripping
rules.description: Deduction for email session downgrade to cleartext transport.

rules.title: Hostname / SAN Mismatch
rules.description: Deduction for mismatch between client SNI and certificate SAN/CN.

rules.title: Certificate Chain Trust Path Failure
rules.description: Deduction for unanchored or broken certificate validation chain.

rules.title: Revoked Certificate In Use
rules.description: Critical deduction for active use of an authoritatively revoked certificate.
